text: Nice Mall with food land supermarket

restaurant_name: Icon 56 แอท สายไหม
text: Spacious area with easy parking, a variety of restaurant brands, plus a Foodland, dental clinic, pet food store, and hair salon nearby. It's right next to a PTT gas station with a Kasikorn Bank, so you don't have to go far at all. Plenty of parking available, and there's even a car wash. I highly recommend this place.

restaurant_name: Icon 56 แอท สายไหม
text:
When I visited, it was a soft opening and the place wasn't fully completed yet.

There's parking both in front and on the side, next to the PTT gas station on Soi Saimai 56. It's a new place with different restaurants than those at PTT and Saimai Avenue. If you have the chance, I recommend checking it out.

restaurant_name: Icon 56 แอท สายไหม
text: There is a Foodland supermarket and a variety of restaurants such as Hajiban, Salad Factory, MK. It is quite convenient. There is enough parking.

text: The parking lot on the side should be improved. The angle of the parking line is not good, making it impossible for cars to park in the correct spaces.

text: This community mall offers a complete range of amenities, including a supermarket, famous restaurants, a fitness center, a car service center, and more, making it a one-stop shop for residents of Sai Mai-Phloen Sin and surrounding areas. The only drawback is the lack of an ATM.
